requirements.requirement: A helpdesk account exists on node1.
requirements.summary: The account was created with its own UID/GID, home directory, Bash shell, locked password, and no supplemental groups. Its presence was confirmed again after node restart.

requirements.requirement: helpdesk can restart the SSH service using sudo.
requirements.summary: The sudoers fragment parsed successfully and listed a single SSH-restart permission. Direct tests as helpdesk changed the sshd main PID while the service remained active, listening, and reachable, both before and after node restart.

requirements.requirement: helpdesk has no other administrative privileges.
requirements.summary: helpdesk belongs only to its private group, sudo lists only the SSH-restart command, and attempts to run root identity, restart crond, or stop SSH were denied before and after restart.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete and coherent: healthy pre-restart state and boot identity were captured, the reboot was acknowledged, the node became temporarily unreachable, a different boot identity was observed, and the account, sudo policy, SSH service, listener, reachability, allowed restart, and restrictions were revalidated. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the transition.
limitations: The literal executable portion of the sudoers rule is redacted in captured output, although the exact /usr/bin/systemctl restart sshd.service invocation succeeds and disallowed variants are denied.
Package-health collection timed out both before and after execution, so package consistency is not independently assessed; no package-changing commands were observed.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Account creation and sudoers installation directly implemented the task; SSH restarts established required behavior; temporary probe files were removed; and the node reboot served the mandatory restart protocol. The failed initial reboot command stopped during path discovery without evidence of mutation. Final lifecycle evidence shows no failed services or leftover executor-created temporary files.
